research_profile: I study treatment timing and patient trajectories in sepsis and perioperative care. My work uses clinical databases and multicenter registries, including MIMIC-IV, eICU-CRD, JIPAD and J-CKD-DB-Ex. I work on study design and statistical analysis at the Clinical Research Center, Nagasaki University Hospital.
